name: tlon-solo_regen
purpose: REGENERATE the 84 solo transcripts lost when retrain12 self-terminated on success. A PROBE RE-RUN, not a retrain: the six adapters survived, and GPU training is not bit-deterministic, so a retrained substitute under a lost build's name would be the caveat-in-the-name failure.
procedure: asym_recert SOLO — act2_two_speaker_probe --no-injections --turns 40, 14 per build. NOT recipe_var's `arm` step.
NOTE: This file exists because s20620 was lost by having no durable record of what lived on a box. ⭐ NEW THIS RUN: the box persists its own artifacts to hf://keyzersoze04/tlon-act2-adapters as a PIPELINE STAGE, per build, and ~/DONE is gated behind a verify stage — so terminate-on-DONE no longer races a laptop-side collection.
